caption: Paired differences in OMIM facts conveyed (percentage points; mean over entries with 95% bootstrap interval over entries), on all facts and on facts the supplied text states (papers readable in full; papers readable as abstract only) or does not state; whether the text states a fact is a model judgement, not checked by a curator. All panels share one scale but not one range. (a) Agentic curator, evidence graph and case table first minus direct reading, all after the repair round, on the 93 entries of the main comparison. (b) A separate comparison with its own baseline and entries: ways of reading better minus direct reading's draft before repair (no arm repaired), on held-out entries with at least one paper readable in full (38 entries; 35 for checklist plus completeness pass). Each panel averages over the entries with facts of its kind (a: 93, 40, 79, 90; b: 38, 34, 31, 36, or 35, 32, 28, 33 for the combined arm). Memory only and recall, then verify are omitted: on all facts and stated facts they lie 34.0 to 77.6 points below direct reading; on facts not stated, memory only is +1.3 (-1.4 to +4.6) and recall, then verify -4.8 (-6.7 to -3.0). Case table first falls behind on all facts (-1.9, -3.1 to -0.7) and most on stated facts in full-text papers (-8.4, -14.3 to -3.8); no interval of the evidence graph or the agentic curator excludes zero (the curator's on all facts ends at +0.0). The completeness pass, alone or after the checklist, gains most on stated facts in full-text papers (+4.5, +2.9 to +6.3; +6.3, +4.0 to +8.7), and its intervals on facts the text does not state include zero; the checklist's gain is small (+1.6, +0.5 to +2.7; sign test not below 0.05 after Holm adjustment), and the three-draft merge also gains on facts the text does not state (+1.5, +0.4 to +2.7).
description: Two-block forest plot, 5.48 x 2.72 in (ICLR text width; include at \linewidth), 4 facet columns: All facts | Stated, full-text papers | Stated, abstract-only papers | Not stated. Point = paired difference in OMIM facts conveyed (mean over entries, pp), whisker = 95% bootstrap interval; vertical line at 0 in every panel; one common x scale (about 1.6 mm per point), each facet spanning only its data's range (-5.5 to +6; -15 to +9.5; -5.5 to +5.5; -5.5 to +5.5). Block a 'Other designs (93 entries)', circles, x label 'Difference from direct reading after repair (percentage points)', log Sec. 2.10a: agentic curator #56B4E9, evidence graph #009E73, case table first #D55E00. Block b 'Ways of reading better (held-out entries with full text)', diamonds, x label 'Difference from direct reading before repair (percentage points)', log Sec. 15 (D1-D3 evaluation tables; D4 'D4 - baseline (primary)' rows): Checklist (38) #8C8C8C, Completeness pass (38) #3D6F98, Three-draft merge (38) #555555, Checklist + completeness pass (35) #003A5E, a dotted rule separating the 35-entry row. Blocks separated by a rule and a gap; no legend, no equivalence or noise band, no numeric labels; memory-first rows omitted (caption). Text 7 pt minimum.
